title: Mario's earlier hypnotic regression triggers atrial fibrillation

tellings.quote: The regression itself, which caused Mario to relive the experience, was so traumatic for him that it caused his heart to go into atrial fibrillation.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods, who says he was abducted by aliens, went through hypnotic regression, a hypnosis method meant to bring back buried memories, and reliving the experience was so traumatic that his heart went into atrial fibrillation. Michels tells this himself in an episode where Woods and other veterans who say they were taken together meet again 50 years later, offering it as a sign of how real the memory feels to him.
